subject: voice model residency outlives a transport socket without losing lifecycle truth
defects_closed: every voice WebSocket constructed and destroyed independent ASR and TTS model owners, turning reconnect into repeated weight load and kernel compilation
mlx-whisper's single process-global ModelHolder evicted the partial model when final transcription ran and evicted the final model on the next partial decode
multiple sockets could repeat the same cold warmup concurrently
native MLX import occurred synchronously on the WebSocket event loop before authorization monitoring could run
a runtime-hygiene close could leave the process singleton pointing at a dead voice model owner
voice.ready could be emitted from dependency availability even when ASR or TTS warmup had failed
model residency, warm state, lane ownership, and closure were not observable without loading models

implementation.process_owner: VoiceModelRuntime owns one shared Whisper backend and one thread-safe StreamingTts until model-lane eviction or process shutdown
implementation.session_isolation: each socket receives fresh LocalAgreement transcript buffers over the shared ASR backend
implementation.mlx_residency: a process fence restores cached model objects into mlx-whisper's holder, retaining partial and final checkpoints without alternating reload
implementation.warmup: ASR model warmup is per-repository single-flight and TTS warmup is process single-flight
implementation.event_loop: native ASR imports happen only on the offloaded warm/decode thread; construction and authorization remain non-loading
implementation.readiness: preparing is a real session state and voice.ready is withheld unless both ASR and TTS return usable warm state
implementation.recovery: a closed singleton is replaced on the next admitted socket while runtime shutdown still releases model references, MLX cache, TTS workers, and leases
implementation.status_receipt: aura.voice.process_model_runtime.v1 distinguishes presence, closure, backend, native import, retained and warmed models, lane ownership, active synthesis, and engine state

verification.discovery_run: 133 passed and one order-dependent paired-revocation timeout; traced to synchronous native import before authorization monitor scheduling and fixed before the green rerun

claim_boundary.reason: bounded lifecycle tests do not replace rebuilt-app measurement on the physical microphone, resident checkpoints, and speaker

next_voice_priority.subject: canonical microphone authority and audio ingress broker
next_voice_priority.reason: the runtime still has multiple native and browser microphone owners; voice.input_enabled is not yet a global hardware revocation switch
